parameters.name: integration_instance_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated Amazon integration instance IDs to filter by. Omit to include all instances.

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Searches id, fnsku, msku, asin, reference_id and title.

parameters.name: filter[event_type]
parameters.description: Exact event type. One of: RECEIVED, DEPARTED.

parameters.name: filter[has_provisional_cogs]
parameters.description: 1 = only entries with provisional COGS, 0 = exclude them.

parameters.name: filter[link_status]
parameters.description: Link state. One of: linked, not_linked.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Allowed: id, date, fnsku, msku, reference_id, quantity, created_at, updated_at. Prefix with - for descending. Default: -date.
